Harsh Sharma
Senior React Native Developer | Bengaluru
harsh.sharma691@example.com | +91 9406018611

Experienced mobile developer focused on building performant cross-platform React Native apps with strong emphasis on TypeScript, state management and analytics-driven improvements. Proven track record delivering customer-facing features, reducing crash rates and improving release velocity in Agile teams. Open to relocating to Chennai or Hyderabad. Notice period: 15 days.

Experience

CartNest — May 2022 - Present
Senior React Native Developer (Remote)

- Integrated Firebase analytics and remote config to run targeted experiments, increasing repeat purchase rate by 18% and improving retention for a key cohort.
- Built and maintained unit and integration tests with Jest covering 72% of core checkout flows, reducing production regressions by 60%.
- Optimized app startup and memory usage, decreasing cold start time by 25% and crash-free sessions by 12% through performance profiling and Redux store tuning.

Pixelwave Studios — Jul 2021 - Apr 2022
React Native Developer (Hybrid)
- Implemented customer and admin modules using React Native and TypeScript, leveraging GraphQL for efficient data fetching and reducing network payloads by 35%.
- Integrated Firebase Authentication and Firestore for real-time features, enabling live updates that increased user engagement by 22%.
- Standardized Redux middlewares and selectors across projects, improving maintainability and reducing bug turnaround time by 28%.
- Developed Jest test suites for critical components, enabling safe refactors and improving CI pass rates.

Medisure — Feb 2018 - Jun 2021
React Native Developer (On-site)
- Built patient-facing mobile features in React Native with TypeScript, delivering appointment booking and records modules used by 50k+ users.
- Implemented Firebase Cloud Messaging and Firestore offline sync to ensure reliable notifications and data access, cutting support tickets related to sync by 45%.
- Designed Redux state shape and implemented async flows to simplify complex form flows, reducing customer drop-off during checkout by 20%.
- Wrote Jest tests for form validation and data flows to prevent regressions and supported Agile sprints with regular demos and retrospective-driven improvements.
